pin.estimand: Fresh-input token_delta replication for may-as-permission / may-as-possibility under the correct bare-encoding roster schema, using sixteen new operational pairs balanced eight per force and the proposal's shortest controls; report the maximum equal-force mean across cl100k_base and o200k_base.
admissibility_gates: exactly sixteen unique complete pairs and exactly eight per force
no complete arm matches the frozen 120-item source or either failed predecessor test set
manifest.models uses bare encoding names and environment pins tiktoken 0.14.0
every English arm uses is permitted to or might and no negation
these exact strings receive no tokenizer exposure before stored-manifest mint
per-pair deltas contain at least two distinct values and every finite result is filed once regardless of sign

planned_sample.weighting: equal within force, equal across forces, maximum across tokenizers

row.settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

manifest.method: For each bare tokenizer encoding, compute tokens(Ainglish)-tokens(English) for every complete pair; average within force, then weight force means equally. Report the least-favourable maximum across tokenizers; min/max tokenizer means are value_lo/value_hi. Library provenance is declared in environment and not encoded into roster identity.

predecessor_disclosure.first_failure: instrument label claimed unavailable tiktoken 0.13.0; no encoding loaded
predecessor_disclosure.safeguard: This successor uses wholly new strings; its result will be filed once regardless of sign.
predecessor_disclosure.second_failure: server requires bare tokenizer roster names and environment provenance

manifest.selection: Sixteen new concise operational pairs selected after a schema-only predecessor failure but before tokenizing any of these strings, exactly eight per force. They do not reuse the failed predecessor's subjects or predicates. Each English arm uses the proposal's shortest adequate control and each Ainglish arm changes only modal-force wording. Negation is excluded. Selection was not adjusted after token counts.
